text: Would you bet over four hundred million dollars... on one ancient story?
That's reportedly what India spent on Ramayana, across two films. Part one opened November fifth, two days before Diwali.
Ranbir Kapoor plays Ram. Sai Pallavi is Sita. And Yash plays the demon king, Ravana!
Three days in, it reportedly crossed one hundred fifty crore rupees in India alone.
And overseas? Around ten million dollars... in just two days.
Diwali is one of India's biggest festival seasons, and this epic is betting the whole holiday weekend on itself.
The catch? Trackers disagree on the opening day... so treat every number as an estimate.
My take? When the story is thousands of years old, the hype comes pre-installed.
